verses.text: Praise the LORD! It is good to sing praises to our God. It is pleasant and right to praise him.
The LORD is rebuilding Jerusalem. He is bringing back the scattered people of Israel.
He heals those whose hearts are broken and bandages their wounds.
He counts the stars and calls each one by name.
Our Lord is great and very powerful. There is no limit to his understanding.
The LORD lifts up humble people, but he throws the wicked to the ground.
Sing to the LORD with thanks. Make music to our God on the harp.
He covers the sky with clouds. He sends rain to the earth and makes grass grow on the hills.
He gives food to the cattle and to the young ravens when they call.
He is not impressed by the strength of a horse or the power of a man's legs.
The LORD is pleased with those who respect him, with those who hope in his faithful love.
Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
He makes the bars of your gates strong. He blesses your people inside your walls.
He brings peace to your borders. He fills you with the finest wheat.
He sends his command to the earth. His word runs quickly.
He spreads snow like wool and scatters frost like ashes.
He throws down hail like pebbles. Who can stand his freezing cold?
Then he sends his word and melts them. He makes his wind blow, and the waters flow.
He has made his word known to Jacob, his laws and rules to Israel.
He has not done this for any other nation. They do not know his rules. Praise the LORD!
